mapper.sql: id, create_user_id, create_user_name, create_time, update_user_id, update_user_name, update_time, version, is_deleted, erp_user_id, kingdee_post_id
mapper.select: SELECT krp.code AS kingdeePostCode, krp.use_org_id, krp.use_org_name, kd.kingdee_dept_code AS kingdeeDeptCode, kd.kingdee_dept_name AS kingdeeDeptName, kp.name AS postName FROM kingdee_user_ref_post krp LEFT JOIN kingdee_department kd ON krp.kingdee_department_id=kd.id LEFT JOIN kingdee_post kp ON krp.kingdee_post_id=kp.id AND kp.is_deleted=false WHERE krp.is_deleted = false AND krp.erp_user_id=#{userId} AND krp.use_org_id=#{orgId}
